review_type: Independent hostile source review at the strictest adversarial parity bar. Verified targeted improvements in commit 8042a635554ece055623f0978b1ec65e197cf5cb against reference/MissionPlanner sources: CommsBLE (simpleble-c dynamic loader scaffolding), CommsWinUSB (winusb dynamic loader scaffolding), mobile speech dispatch (Android intent/termux dispatch, iOS utterance logging stub), and iOS packaging/simulator verification test suite (scripts/test_ios_packaging.py).
verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity (Score: 5.0/10, capped at 5.0 due to open P1 findings). Commit 8042a63 introduced Windows LoadLibraryA probing for simpleble-c.dll and winusb.dll, added Android intent broadcasting and iOS logging scaffolding to speech.rs, and verified host-independent iOS bundle packaging and simulator receipt verification in scripts/test_ios_packaging.py (5 passed unit tests). However, under the hostile adversarial audit standard, a partial match or stub receives zero credit. Both targeted P1 findings remain unresolved: BleTransport and WinUsbTransport drop their DLL handles immediately after loading and continue to read/write from in-memory VecDeque buffers without binding SimpleBLE or WinUSB C API symbols or hardware endpoints (R50-01); iOS speech synthesis is an empty unsafe block that only logs an informational string with no AVFoundation FFI (R50-01); Android speech relies on CLI subprocesses ('termux-tts-speak' and 'am broadcast') that fail in standard Android sandboxed APK lifecycles without JNI TextToSpeech (R50-01); and end-to-end execution receipts from physical mobile hardware or simulator runtime remain ungenerated in the current environment (R50-02).

findings.subsystem: Comms: Native BLE, WinUSB, and Mobile Speech API Bindings (R49-01 remainder)
evidence: In `crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs`:445-455 and 508-518, `BleTransport` and `WinUsbTransport` execute `LoadLibraryA` to probe `simpleble-c.dll` and `winusb.dll`. However, the returned library handle is never stored or queried for function symbols (`GetProcAddress`). The `Read` and `Write` implementations (lines 465-488 and 528-550) continue to read from and write to in-memory `parking_lot::Mutex<VecDeque<u8>>` buffers (`self.rx_buf` and `self.tx_buf`). No packets or telemetry can flow to or from physical BLE or WinUSB devices.

In `crates/mp-app/src/speech.rs`:51-58, the iOS speech target consists solely of an empty `unsafe` block wrapping `log::info!("iOS AVSpeechSynthesizer dispatching utterance: {clean}")`. No Objective-C runtime calls (`objc_msgSend`) or AVFoundation bindings (`AVSpeechSynthesizer`, `AVSpeechUtterance`) are executed.

In `crates/mp-app/src/speech.rs`:40-49, Android speech invokes subprocess commands (`termux-tts-speak`, `am broadcast`). In standard sandboxed Android app environments, spawning child processes to invoke `am` fails with permissions errors or binary missing errors. A compliant Android TTS implementation requires JNI bindings to `android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech`.
findings.impact: Physical Bluetooth Low Energy hardware dongles and WinUSB devices cannot communicate with vehicles on live links. Telemetry audio callouts remain silent on standard iOS and Android app installations.
findings.required_fix: In mp-core/src/comms.rs, bind SimpleBLE C API functions (`simpleble_adapter_get_handle`, `simpleble_peripheral_connect`, `simpleble_peripheral_write_request`, `simpleble_peripheral_notify`) and WinUSB API functions (`WinUsb_Initialize`, `WinUsb_ReadPipe`, `WinUsb_WritePipe`), routing stream I/O through the driver handles. In mp-app/src/speech.rs, implement an Objective-C FFI bridge for `AVSpeechSynthesizer` on iOS, and a JNI bridge for `TextToSpeech` on Android.

findings.subsystem: Native Delivery: Hardware / Simulator Execution Receipts (R49-02 remainder)
evidence: While `scripts/test_ios_packaging.py` tests bundle construction and receipt validation logic on Windows host, no actual end-to-end execution receipt (such as an actual simulator launch producing `startup.capture.json` and `startup.png`, or a physical device run) is present in the repository or CI logs.
findings.impact: End-to-end touchscreen interactions, mobile windowing lifecycle, and platform permissions remain unverified on target mobile hardware.
findings.required_fix: Provide automated packaging workflows and verifiable runtime capture receipts from simulator or physical mobile devices.

(2) Replace logging/subprocess stubs in mp-app/src/speech.rs with native iOS AVSpeechSynthesizer Objective-C FFI and Android TextToSpeech JNI bindings. (3) Generate verifiable mobile build packaging and simulator execution receipts.
